summary: Extends SIP so a client can ask that responses be sent back to the source address and port the request came from, instead of the port in the Via header. This helps when the client is behind a NAT or firewall that does not allow incoming messages to that port. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: If you send a letter from a place that only accepts replies to the door you used, you want the answer sent there. This memo lets a phone program ask for that.
